confidence_notes: FX is the RBA figure for 18 Nov 2026 (0.6720 USD per AUD), found through search. Food and drink anchors come from one search of crowdsourced Numbeo-style data in lek, converted at roughly 85 lek per USD and adjusted upward for July peak-season coastal pricing. No Saranda-specific cocktail price was found, so cocktail is estimated at about 2.5 times beer, using the Himara guide's 8-15 EUR combined wine and cocktail budget as a rough guide. Wine by the glass uses a general Albania range of 200-400 lek, adjusted upward for peak season. Accommodation is a holistic estimate with no search; July peak prices are volatile and vary widely.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Albanian Riviera resort towns (Ksamil, Himara) and, to a lesser extent, budget Greek coastal towns such as Corfu. Saranda is cheaper than Greece but has strong July seasonal pricing.
